_archetype_metadata.description: Triggered by Stripe webhook for customer.subscription.{created,updated,deleted} events. Verifies HMAC signature, routes via Switch node based on event type, executes branch-specific handlers (welcome email on created, change-notification on updated, retention/winback on deleted). The canonical archetype for any SaaS billing lifecycle automation.
operator_action_required: Replace <STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET> with the customer's whsec_* (from Stripe dashboard → Webhooks)
Replace <CRM_WEBHOOK_URL> with the customer's CRM ingest endpoint (Airtable, HubSpot, custom)
Customize each branch's templates in SET_DEFAULTS — welcome / update / cancellation messages
_archetype_metadata.deliverable_tier: pro ($1,497) — branching logic + 3 outbound channels makes this a non-trivial integration
_archetype_metadata.sovereign_tier_addon: For Sovereign tier deployment, replace Resend with the customer's hosted SMTP, and pipe the CRM webhook to the operator's hosted Postgres-backed customer ledger
_archetype_metadata.license: Efficient Labs n8n archetype library — proprietary, ships under client engagement only

string.name: welcome_html

Hi {{ customer_name }},

Your subscription to {{ product_name }} is active.

string.name: update_html
string.value:
Hi {{ customer_name }},

We made changes to your subscription. Details: {{ change_summary }}.

string.name: cancel_html
string.value:
Hi {{ customer_name }},

Your subscription has been canceled. If this was a mistake, reply to this email and we'll reactivate.
